items.headline: AI stocks rebound as CoreWeave outlook supports the sector
items.summary: AI stocks rebounded, with CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator citing roughly $9 billion in customer prepayments and deposits expected over the next three months as a source of liquidity.

items.headline: Nvidia faces governance and national-security fallout
items.summary: An AP report said Nvidia-related developments could create economic and political risks because AI-sector growth and data-center construction have contributed substantially to recent market gains.

items.headline: The AI industry faces a volatile week involving Nvidia and potential Anthropic IPO activity
items.summary: Axios described a turbulent AI-investment backdrop involving Nvidia, Anthropic’s expected IPO, and heightened scrutiny of the sector.

items.headline: Nvidia leadership uncertainty raises valuation concerns
items.summary: Le Monde reported analyst Dan Ives’s view that Nvidia could be worth 25% to 30% less if Jensen Huang were removed as CEO, with Ives assigning a 15% probability to that scenario.
